name: Wallet Intel — On-chain Wallet Intelligence
description: Structured wallet intelligence for any EVM or Solana address: native balance, token holdings, recent transactions, estimated PnL and AI analysis (is it a bot? a whale? what strategy?). $0.005–$0.02/query via x402.
longDescription: Given a wallet address (EVM 0x… or Solana base58), returns structured JSON with the native balance (ETH/SOL), token holdings valued in USD (Etherscan + Solana RPC, priced via CoinGecko), recent transactions with direction and estimated USD value, a rough PnL estimate, and — when the operator configures a DeepSeek key — an AI analysis classifying the wallet (bot / whale / trader / accumulator / retail) and describing its strategy. Works for wallets on Ethereum and Solana. No KYC, no subscription: agents pay USDC per request on Solana.
